description: Degree conversion keeps a live heading distinct from its frozen radian snapshot
code:
degrees = 90
radians = Math.toRadians(degrees)
frozen = radians.value
assert(radians, Math.PI / 2)
degrees = 180
assert(radians, Math.PI)
assert(frozen, Math.PI / 2)
degrees = -180
assert(radians, -Math.PI)
assert(frozen, Math.PI / 2)
radians

description: Independent antenna headings recover degree conversion after property deletion
code:
class Antenna
$Antenna.radians = Math.toRadians($Antenna.degrees)
first = Antenna()
second = Antenna()
assert(first.radians, null)
first.degrees = 180
second.degrees = 90
assert(first.radians, Math.PI)
assert(second.radians, Math.PI / 2)
delete first.degrees
assert(first.radians, null)
assert(second.radians, Math.PI / 2)
first.degrees = -180
assert(first.radians, -Math.PI)
assert(second.radians, Math.PI / 2)
second.radians

description: Degree conversion retains intrinsic coercion while ignoring nonnumeric extra values
code:
sample = " 180 "
converted = Math.toRadians(sample, Number.NaN)
assert(converted, Math.PI)
sample = ["90"]
assert(converted, Math.PI / 2)
sample = Date(180)
assert(converted, Math.PI)
omitted = Math.toRadians()
assert(Number.isNaN(omitted), true)
zero = Math.toRadians(-0, "invalid", {})
assert(1 / zero, Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
converted

description: A deferred extra and failed transaction preserve a live dial conversion
code:
class Dial
dial = Dial()
dial.degrees = 90
radians = Math.toRadians(dial.degrees, dial.optional)
assert(radians, null)
dial.optional = 1
assert(radians, Math.PI / 2)
try:
    dial.degrees = 180
    throw "CANCEL"
catch error:
    assert(error, "CANCEL")
assert(dial.degrees, 90)
assert(radians, Math.PI / 2)
dial.degrees = -180
assert(radians, -Math.PI)
radians
